label: prose:intro-orphan-reconnect
html: At the substrate level, the spectral and automorphic sides of the Langlands correspondence are tied together by a single chain of constructions. The mutant-Jones / Bloch-group bridge carries the substrate side into the cyclotomic L-value decomposition, which expresses the automorphic data through Dirichlet L-values. The modular S-transform then exchanges the substrate parameter with its dual, and — matched across the mirror 3d-3d correspondence — the quantum Langlands dual pins the resulting spectral / automorphic interchange.
